unit_label: BRBL Module B unit 4: Payment and Settlement Systems Act — Identify delegated regulation-making and keep dated regulations separate from the Act and operating authorisation

facts.statement: Courseware describes section 38 regulations, parliamentary laying, the PSS Regulations 2008 and amendments through 2022; it mentions sanctions but does not develop their detailed current operation.
facts.locator: S04 printed pp. 184–186; PDF page = printed page + 19

facts.statement: Section 38 permits RBI notification of regulations consistent with the Act, covering specified governance, application, authorisation, standards and reporting matters, and provides effective-date and parliamentary-laying arrangements. The dated RBI FAQ instrument inventory is separately sourced in F003.
facts.locator: section 38, PDF p. 17; RBI FAQ 2025 Q3–4, PDF p. 1; PRB Regulations 2025 regulations 1–3, PDF p. 5

facts.statement: RBI FAQ dated 20 October 2025 identifies RBI exercising PSS Act functions through the Payments Regulatory Board, names the PSS Regulations 2008 and PRB Regulations 2025, and explains their roles.
facts.locator: Q1–4, PDF p. 1; Gazette PRB Regulations 2025 separately retained in registry and review record

payload.title: The Act, regulations and an operator's permission do different jobs
payload.core_explanation_md:
**Section 38** authorises RBI to make regulations consistent with the Act. The listed matters include governance procedure, application/authorisation forms, payment-instruction standards and information returns. A regulation develops the statutory framework; it is not the same document as an individual operator's authorisation.

For a compliance file, retain the relevant Act provision, the regulation version and the operator's actual permission and conditions. Reading only an old summary of an application form cannot establish that a new service is authorised or that all current reporting requirements have been met.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a published application-form regulation itself prove that a particular operator has authorisation?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. A general regulation and an individual operating authorisation are different instruments.

payload.title: Use the regulation's own version and commencement evidence
payload.core_explanation_md:
The dated RBI FAQ distinguishes the **Payment and Settlement Systems Regulations, 2008** from the **Payments Regulatory Board Regulations, 2025**. Their subjects differ: system application/authorisation, standards and returns on one side, and Board governance on the other. A courseware note ending at a 2022 amendment does not show that the regulation set stops there.

Section 38 includes effective-date and parliamentary-laying provisions. Use the operative text and notification evidence for the relevant exam cutoff; do not infer commencement from a website folder, a PDF creation timestamp or a document identifier. Sanctions also need their own provisions and review rather than a generic penalty number copied into every situation.

self_check.prompt_text: Why is an old courseware amendment date insufficient to identify all applicable regulations?
self_check.expected_takeaway: It describes the courseware's coverage, not proof that no later instrument or amendment exists.

payload.stem_md: An operator presents the general regulation containing an application form as proof that its own new service has been authorised. What distinction should the reviewer restore?

options.text_md: General regulation-making is separate from the operator's individual authorisation and conditions
options.explanation_md: A standard form describes a process; it does not establish that this operator obtained the required grant.

options.text_md: Publication of general regulations automatically authorises every applicant meeting the form technical fields
options.explanation_md: Meeting general form requirements does not by itself establish an individual operating grant.

options.text_md: A completed application is equivalent to the grant regardless of its effective date
options.explanation_md: Submission is distinct from authorisation, its effective date and compliance with its conditions.

options.text_md: Compliance with the application form eliminates every operating-authorisation condition
options.explanation_md: Form compliance does not remove the terms imposed by the individual authorisation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A standard form describes a process; it does not establish that this operator obtained the required grant.

payload.stem_md: A compliance inventory lists only a 2022-amended courseware link and omits the separately identified 2025 PRB regulations. Which approach is appropriate?

options.text_md: Assume the courseware link proves that no later regulations exist
options.explanation_md: A courseware cutoff does not establish the absence of later legal instruments.

options.text_md: Replace all primary texts with the latest search-result snippet
options.explanation_md: A snippet is not a substitute for inspecting the operative instrument and its applicability.

options.text_md: Treat Board governance regulations and every transaction rule as identical
options.explanation_md: Their subjects and functions differ and should be identified separately.

options.text_md: Reconcile the dated primary instruments and their subjects against the exam cutoff
options.explanation_md: The inventory must account for the later instrument while preserving version and scope distinctions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The inventory must account for the later instrument while preserving version and scope distinctions.

payload.stem_md: Two stored PDFs have different creation timestamps. A reviewer proposes selecting the newer timestamp as the sole test of legal commencement. What should replace that shortcut?

options.text_md: The latest consolidation date alone, without inspecting commencement terms
options.explanation_md: A consolidation date does not itself establish when each provision became operative.

options.text_md: The instrument's commencement wording and authoritative notification/publication evidence
options.explanation_md: Legal commencement depends on the governing instrument, not file metadata alone.

options.text_md: The local download time as the effective date
options.explanation_md: Retrieval records access, not necessarily commencement.

options.text_md: The date the bank first discussed the rule internally
options.explanation_md: Internal discussion does not bring a statutory provision into force.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Legal commencement depends on the governing instrument, not file metadata alone.
